programme.title: Kadha Thudarunnu
programme.desc: Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.

programme.title: Kadal Kadannu Oru Maathukutty
programme.desc: An unemployed man living in Germany receives an opportunity to organise a star-studded event in Kerala. However, chaos ensues when he arrives in the country.

programme.title: Nakshathra Tharattu
programme.desc: Sunil falls head over heels in love with Hema and marries her. However, things take a turn when they both discover that they are orphans.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs.
programme.desc: Zachariah and Balu remain best friends even after their marriage. However, things take a turn when their wives start fighting with each other.

programme.title: Achayans
programme.desc: When a family of four sets out on a road trip, they are accompanied by two girls on their way. However, things take an unexpected turn when one of the girls is found dead.

programme.title: Nokketha Dhoorathu Kannum Nattu
programme.desc: Kunjoonjamma is an elderly woman who lives alone in a village. Her life changes when a girl named Girly claims that she is her granddaughter and comes to live with her.

programme.title: Aanachandam
programme.desc: After an elephant saves him from an accident in childhood, Krishna becomes fond of elephants. His life changes when he decides to adopt Arjunan, a severely injured elephant.

programme.title: Darling Darling
programme.desc: Friends Kochu Kurup and Aniyankutty fall for the same girl, Padmaja. When Aniyankutty discovers that she loves his friend, he plans to sabotage their relationship, resulting in hilarious events.

programme.title: Matchbox
programme.desc: Ambu, a carefree college student, falls in love with a woman he sees at a bus stop. However, before he can confess his feelings, unexpected complications arise.

programme.title: Sukham Sukhakaram
programme.desc: Daniel's grandfather, who is a strict patriarch, has the final say in every decision involving his family. However, things take a turn when he decides to make Daniel a priest.

programme.title: Oozham
programme.desc: After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.

programme.title: Deepangal Sakshi
programme.desc: Rishi is a diligent collector who works honestly for the good of people. However, things take a turn after he draws the attention of corrupt politicians and businessmen who want to cause trouble.

programme.title: Thillana Thillana
programme.desc: Bobby, a college student, mistakes another student named Malavika for an unknown girl who is sending romantic notes to him. Under this impression, he tries to win her heart.

programme.title: Onnam Ragam
programme.desc: Kavitha, a struggling woman, goes through a difficult time while repaying her brother's debts. Later, she takes up an acting job for a commercial and things change drastically.

programme.title: Lucky Jokers
programme.desc: A prince sets out on a hunt to find the diamonds that belonged to his ancestors. He faces challenges when he encounters several frauds who try to mislead him.

programme.title: Female Unnikrishnan
programme.desc: Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.

programme.title: Kuruppinte Kanakkupusthakam
programme.desc: Vinayan, a rich businessman, tries to help everyone in need and always takes care of his family. However, things take an ugly turn when during a fight he accuses his wife of being infertile.

programme.title: Payyans
programme.desc: Josy is an unemployed young man who never acts responsibly. His life changes when his beloved mother dies in a fatal accident and his long-lost father returns home.

programme.title: Detective
programme.desc: Reshmi, the wife of a young political leader, Mohan Kumar, commits suicide just when he is gearing up for a by-election. An inquiry team led by Shyam Prasad is tasked to find out the reason behind it.

programme.title: Pulival Kalyanam
programme.desc: Harikrishnan is an adopted younger brother of Karunan. When Karunan loses his right hand in an accident, Harikrishnan decides to look after his family.

programme.title: Immanuvel
programme.desc: Immanuel's life takes an odd turn when the publishing firm that he works for shuts down. He gets a job in an insurance company but faces severe hardships, which end up changing him as a person.

programme.title: Onnaman
programme.desc: Ravishankar, a street urchin, is looked after by Salim, a local don. After Salim's demise, Ravishankar rises to power and fights against an evil gangster.

programme.title: Mayamayooram
programme.desc: Maheshwar struggles to raise Malu, his 5-year-old daughter, who holds him responsible for her mother's passing. Ganga attempts to mend the rift between them.

programme.title: Sreeragam
programme.desc: Bringing the best in cinema.

programme.title: Kanamarayathu
programme.desc: Sherly, an orphan, falls in love with Roy not knowing that he is her financial supporter. However, Roy keeps his distance from her due to their age gap.

programme.title: Kelkkaatha Sabdham
programme.desc: Babu, a womaniser, falls in love with a village girl named Jayanthi and vows to marry her. However, due to unexpected circumstances, his father refuses to approve of their marriage.

programme.title: Maratha Nadu
programme.desc: Religious intolerance in a small faction results in a communal riot. A Muslim father is torn apart when his daughter requests him to marry her off to her Hindu lover.

programme.title: Black Stalion
